result.reason: The redline minimally improves the warranty period to 90 days from acceptance and preserves the existing correction, replacement, and refund structure. However, it does not fully reach even the fallback because it adds no professional-and-workmanlike services warranty or compliance-with-laws warranty, and the malicious-code warranty remains limited to code that was “willfully introduced,” rather than covering malicious code generally. The margin comment does not cure these omissions in the operative language. The acceptance-based trigger may also be ambiguous if acceptance is not defined elsewhere.
